svg.text: A finder for every case it verifies (amber hooks) and a platform for every statement a reporter submits (teal hooks),
on one intake, one case pipeline, two sandbox backends and two keys.

svg.text: a transcript leaf per model turn and tool call
the recording provider wraps every model call with the case id; sandbox tool calls are
leaves too; bodies never enter a leaf, only digests
after the re-run fails by assertion:
with family and serving mode, signed by
after review: diff digest, files touched
the finder's own review is informational
on the case and in the
git worktree per case; scrubbed env; rlimits (CPU, memory, files,
processes); wall clock; egress cut by unshare -n on Linux, sandbox-
exec (deny network*) on macOS; host filesystem still readable
an isolated sandbox VM per case: egress killswitch, east-west and
metadata guards; the receipt names the class
signs receipts and ledger countersignatures; an ephemeral key is refused
signs qudisclose's own Finding and Patch statements (finder role)
finders, platform and maintainer countersigners, providers, roots, logs;
validity windows; never an enclave key
finder role: qudisclose attests its own case
Nothing in the pipeline waits for a human unless policy says so; the verified level is recorded and routes the case, it never opens a pull request by itself.
